statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I34.0 (nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency) was used
The diagnosis code R42 (dizziness and giddiness) was used
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
